name: Top One Futures

programs.name: Elite Daily
programs.payout_rules_note: Elite Daily V2 (help center): minimum payout $500, maximum $1,000 per request, $2,500 payout buffer on 50K; at least 50% of each payout must come from profit made since the last payout. Funded drawdown locks at $50,100; no consistency rule in funded.
programs.notes: Daily loss limit can be switched off (No DLL option).

news_trading: Allowed (per Top One Futures' homepage comparison)
path_to_live: Risk-manager review after 3 successful payouts on one sim funded account; Elite Daily accounts need 5 successful payouts. A Pre-Live stage comes first; up to 5 live accounts, adding one each time a live account reaches its balance trigger (help center).

current_public_promo.applies_to: Elite Daily (homepage 'Black November' banner: up to 60% off with code BLACKFRIDAY; Ignite shown at 60% off, Instant Sim Funded at 30% off)

pros: No activation fee on the 50K Elite Daily
Daily payouts on the Elite Daily account
A daily loss limit is optional
cons: Company details, payout methods and country rules not checked yet
Newer firm with a short track record
best_for: Futures day traders who want daily payouts and an end-of-day drawdown and accept a monthly fee and a consistency rule.

sources.supports: 50K Elite Daily price, rules, reset fee, codes (checked in browser); prices by account size
Elite Daily V2 50K rules, payout minimum/maximum, buffer, 90/10
checkout options: Daily loss limit Standard or None

uncertain: Legal entity, payout methods, platforms, restricted countries and US access not yet verified.
Reset fee: data keeps $104; on 2026-11-16 the homepage Elite Daily 50K block showed $93 and the Elite Daily V2 help article $82. Not changed until the firm's pages agree.
Daily loss limit: checkout offers 'Daily loss limit: None', but the Elite Daily V2 help article says a DLL applies in evaluation and funded.
Max accounts: help center gives up to 38 active funded accounts in total (34 with 100K/150K Sim accounts); the per-household limit is in a separate article not read.

allocation.max_accounts: Limits per account type (for example 5 Elite Daily funded accounts), up to 38 funded accounts in total per household. All accounts in a type must be the same size.
allocation.scaling_text: No account-size scaling; contract limits rise with profit. Live traders get another live account at set balances, up to 5.
